templates._comment: TEMPLATE — per-change-type checklists used by visual-verify-nudge.js. Chrome MCP primary, Playwright fallback. Tab discipline: tabs_context_mcp first, reuse tab, never open a duplicate in the other MCP. Customise the 'data' steps below to point at your actual data source MCP (Postgres, Supabase, D1, Prisma, Drizzle, etc.).

steps: Tab discipline: mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp first → reuse a tab whose URL already matches; create new only if none. Never open a second tab in the other MCP.
Navigate (primary): mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate to the dev server URL — fallback: mcp__playwright__browser_navigate
Capture: mcp__claude-in-chrome__get_page_text or read_page — fallback: mcp__playwright__browser_take_screenshot
Identify the data source (your DB / API endpoint) for the new field
Query the source via your DB MCP (e.g. mcp__postgres-dev__query, mcp__supabase__query, etc.) — confirm rows exist
Tab discipline: mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp first → reuse the tab if already open
Navigate + capture: Chrome MCP primary (navigate + get_page_text/read_page), Playwright fallback (browser_navigate + browser_take_screenshot) — same tab
Verify rendered value matches source value
Tab discipline: mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp first → reuse the tab if already open
Click / type: mcp__claude-in-chrome__form_input or shortcuts_execute — fallback: mcp__playwright__browser_click / browser_type
Capture post-interaction state in same tab
